user.title: Bambu Printer Webhook
user.description: Every Bambu Lab printer set up through the Bambu Lab integration sends its state to this webhook. A test message is sent first to check the address and token.

data_description.webhook_url: Where the printer state is sent, as a POST with a JSON body.
data_description.token: Sent along as a bearer token in the Authorization header.

error.invalid_url: Enter a full http:// or https:// address.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach this address. Check it, and that Home Assistant can reach the internet.
error.wrong_endpoint: This address does not take printer states. Check the full path, not just the domain.
error.unexpected_response: The webhook gave an unexpected answer to a test message. Check the address and the receiver's logs.

abort.already_configured: This webhook is already set up.
